content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) Recruitment 2026 for 1156 posts of Junior Engineer (Mechanical) and other technical posts has been announced. Candidates with relevant engineering qualifications and valid UPSSSC PET 2025 scores can Apply Online. The online application opens on 03-11-2026 and ends on 25-11-2026. Candidates can apply through the official UPSSSC website, upsssc.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification Overview
content_sections.text: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has officially released a recruitment notification for 1156 vacancies across various Uttar Pradesh government departments. For complete details regarding eligibility, the recruitment process, department-wise vacancies and application procedures, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.uttar_pradesh_subordinate_services_selec: Application Fee General/OBC/EWS: Rs. 25/- SC/ST: Rs. 25/- Online Processing Fee: Rs. 25/- for all categories Shortlisted candidates must pay the prescribed Main Examination Fee separately before downloading the admit card.

UPSSSC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates Notification Date: 12-10-2026 Starting Date for Apply Online: 03-11-2026 Last Date for Apply Online: 25-11-2026 Last Date for Fee Payment: 25-11-2026 Last Date for Fee Adjustment and Application Correction: 02-12-2026 Main Examination Date: To Be Announced

UPSSSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit Minimum Age: 18 or 21 Years (Post-wise) Maximum Age: 40 Years Age Limit is calculated as per the applicable departmental service rules. Age relaxation is applicable for eligible reserved categories as per Uttar Pradesh Government rules.

Qualification Candidates should possess the prescribed Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or other relevant engineering qualification according to the post. Relevant engineering branches and equivalent qualifications are accepted only as specified in the official notification. Candidates must have appeared in UPSSSC PET 2025 and have a scorecard issued by the Commission. Shortlisting for the Main Examination will be based on the normalized UPSSSC PET 2025 score. Candidates should check the post-wise educational qualifications in the official notification before applying.

Salary Junior Engineer (Mechanical) and other Level-6 posts: Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400 Mechanic: Rs. 5,200 - Rs. 20,200 (Pay Level-5) Assistant Bhandarpal: Rs. 5,200 - Rs. 20,200 (Pay Level-4) Junior Engineer (Mechanical), Local Bodies Directorate: Rs. 9,300 - Rs. 34,800 with Grade Pay Rs. 4,200 Other allowances are applicable as per government and departmental rules.
Selection Process Shortlisting based on UPSSSC PET 2025 Score Written Main Examination Document Verification Other prescribed formalities as per rules

Main Examination Pattern Total Questions: 100 Total Marks: 100 Examination Duration: 120 Minutes Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks for each incorrect answer Part 1: Technical Subjects - 65 Marks Part 2: Computer and Information Technology - 15 Marks Part 3: General Knowledge of Uttar Pradesh - 20 Marks

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in UPSSSC Junior Engineer Mechanical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1156 vacancies have been announced across various departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for UPSSSC Junior Engineer Mechanical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application submission and fee payment is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When will UPSSSC Junior Engineer Mechanical applications start?
faq.answer: Online applications will start on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is UPSSSC PET 2025 compulsory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have appeared in UPSSSC PET 2025 and been issued a PET 2025 scorecard. Main examination shortlisting is based on normalized PET 2025 scores.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for UPSSSC Junior Engineer Mechanical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application processing fee is Rs. 25 for all categories. A separate main examination fee will be payable by shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How many Mechanic vacancies are available in UPSRTC?
faq.answer: The Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation has 270 Mechanic vacancies under this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. How many Junior Engineer Mechanical vacancies are available in the Irrigation Department?
faq.answer: The notification lists 304 regular Junior Engineer (Mechanical) vacancies and 154 vacancies under special selection in the Irrigation and Water Resources Department.

faq.question: Q8. What is the UPSSSC Junior Engineer Mechanical salary?
faq.answer: The advertised pay depends on the post and department. Several posts carry Level 6 with the pay scale of Rs. 35,400-1,12,400, while other positions carry different pay levels and pay-band structures.

faq.question: Q9. What is the UPSSSC Junior Engineer Mechanical exam pattern?
faq.answer: The main examination contains 100 objective questions for 100 marks, with a duration of two hours and negative marking of 0.25 marks for an incorrect answer.

faq.question: Q10. What is the maximum age limit for UPSSSC Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general maximum age limit is 40 years, subject to applicable departmental rules and age relaxation.
